title: Women Mother Gown, Soft Cotton Blend, Red Checks, Free Size, Concealed Zip Feeding Access, Pregnancy & Nursing Nighty
description: Celebrate the beautiful journey of motherhood in comfort and style with this Women's Maternity Feeding Gown. Crafted from a soft cotton blend fabric, this gown is gentle on the skin and keeps you feeling fresh and comfortable throughout the day. The charming red checks pattern gives it a stylish and trendy look, making it perfect for both lounging at home and casual outings. Designed with a concealed zip feeding access, this gown is thoughtfully made to support nursing mothers, offering easy and discreet breastfeeding convenience. The empire waist with gathered fabric below provides ample room to accommodate your growing baby bump, ensuring a relaxed and flattering fit at every stage of pregnancy. Available in a free size that fits most body types, this lightweight and breathable gown is ideal for expecting and new mothers alike. The round neckline, short sleeves, and full-length silhouette add to its graceful appeal. Whether you are resting, recovering, or going about your daily routine, this maternity nighty is your perfect companion through pregnancy and beyond. Please refer to the size chart before ordering.

specifications.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash Cold With Similar Colours; Use Mild Detergent; Do Not Bleach; Tumble Dry Low; Warm Iron If Needed; Do Not Dry Clean
